quarterly_data.quarter: FPT Corporation earnings report: Earnings Report 6M2026 (07-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FPT (earnings report): 6M2026 revenue was VND 26,269 billion (6M2025: 23,326), profit before tax VND 5,714 billion (4,838), profit after tax VND 5,047 billion (4,427) and PAT attributable to the parent company's shareholders VND 5,055 billion (4,432); from 2026 FPT Telecom is consolidated by the equity method, with 2025 figures adjusted the same way.
